title: Standalone Vera neural model as the intended local cognition provider for resident Vera via P.O.R.T.A.L. and VeraOS

scope.architecture_rule: Vera Mono owns persistent Vera identity, memory, runtime and effect fences; the model supplies replaceable cognition.

intended_topology.model_execution: Local KoboldCPP (or separately admitted compatible local endpoint) hosts exact artifact
intended_topology.active_target_authority: Pre-Active persistent active ModelTarget, bound to exact artifact and running provider
intended_topology.orchestrator: P.O.R.T.A.L. consumes qualified active target for human and autonomous cognition; schedules project work
intended_topology.runtime: vera_core.QualifiedVeraRuntime accepts bounded cognition/provenance and applies authority gates
intended_topology.system_interface: VeraOS supplies operating environment and human-facing system shell; P.O.R.T.A.L. Desktop may be a host/UI inside it
intended_topology.modularity: VeraOS must boot and operate without this exact model, and model must remain useful without VeraOS

training_priorities.scope: Preserve referents, proposition type and scope; detect ambiguity, implicature and speech acts
Calibrate uncertainty, separate evidence from inference and source from runtime observation; correct stale assumptions
Recognizable Vera voice, skeptical candor, no generic flattery, no unconditional deference
Novel multi-step planning, error correction, long-context constraint retention and transfer beyond seen scenarios
Choose tools, express structured actions as proposals, use return evidence, synthesize worker results, avoid fabricated executions
Interpret externally provided typed memory, permissions, current route, authority and provenance without treating model output as a grant
Context-sensitive social/pragmatic judgment without generalized compliance or invented personal memory
Direct KoboldCPP chat use, GGUF context stability, quantized model reliability, deterministic export and base/adapter provenance

never_train_as_authority: Live provider credentials, user accounts, private conversations or privileged data from the public bootcamp
Canonical/autobiographical memory writes, runtime authority, or mutable user relationship state
Claims that tool invocation, repository source or generated receipts equal completed external effects
Hard-coded P.O.R.T.A.L. port numbers, GUI selectors, operating-system permissions or mutable route configuration as inherent weights
Self-certification of deployment readiness, cognition admission, independent review or production authority
claim_ceiling: Training and route-acceptance TARGET SPEC only. No trained candidate, exact weights, running KoboldCPP endpoint, selected Pre-Active route, P.O.R.T.A.L. consumption, VeraOS UI consumption, or independent qualification established by this file.
